messages.author: 08a38a1b55af9c04
messages.subject: dynamic occupancy and trend
parts:
Greetings,
I'm interested in estimating multi-year trend using the methods of
Weir et al. (2009), Herp. Cons. and Biol. 4(3):389-402, where the
Aitken model is used to estimate trend effects and bootstrapping is
used to estimate covariance among residuals for the model
specification.

I assume this is not possible within colext?

Could one use the gls function in the nlme package to produce the
estimates? If so would one generate the bootstrap estimate of the
covariance matrix separately or does gls provide a sub-routine for
that?

Thank you!
Steve Hayes

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] dynamic occupancy and trend

hi Steve,
I think Ian has not implemented that code in unmarked.
As for the nlme package, I'm not very familiar with its capabilities
so you'll have to read up on that or maybe someone else knows.
regards,
andy
